predecessors.name: Electorate of Saxony
predecessors.text: Meissen and northern Thuringia, partitioned off in 1485

successors.name: Electorate of Saxony
successors.text: Albert received 'the Saxon ducal title, rule over the old Margraviate of Meissen' and 'domains in northern Thuringia'

ledger.x: 1485: Treaty of Leipzig splits the Wettin lands; Albert takes Meissen, northern Thuringia and the ducal title, with Dresden as centre.
1547: Duke Maurice gains the electorate after the Schmalkaldic War; the duchy becomes the Electorate of Saxony.

certainty.note: Page gives no limits or areas; polygon is a reading.
